sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings Warnings: (1) Inspect product before use: do not use if appearance is abnormal, including instances of turbid solution, foreign material, loose seal, or leakage. (2) For single use only. (3) Use as directed by a physician. (4) Using one patient only on one occasion only. (5) Contains no antimicrobial preservatives. (6) Use sterile equipment for IV infusion. (7) Discard any unused mixture. (8) Keep out of reach of children.
